sections.title: What is Jeevan Umang (Plan 945)?
sections.description: In simple words: Pay for a fixed period (e.g., 15 years) and get a guaranteed, tax-free income for life (from year 16 to age 100).

content.text: Jeevan Umang is a participating whole-life plan that provides an ongoing (lifelong) survival income after the premium paying term. It combines life insurance protection with a recurring income stream â€” making it attractive for retirement planning. Compare this plan with Jeevan Anand, Jeevan Labh, and Jeevan Utsav using our LIC calculators. The plan also accrues bonuses and may include final additional bonuses where applicable. You can get more details from the official LIC Jeevan Umang page.

sections.title: How the LIC Jeevan Umang Calculator Works
sections.description: The formulas and assumptions behind your benefit calculation.

content.heading: Premium Calculation
content.body: The calculator uses LIC's base premium rates based on your age, sum assured, and PPT. It then applies standard modal loading factors for non-yearly payments and adds GST (4.5% 1st year, 2.25% thereafter).

content.heading: Survival & Maturity Benefits
content.body: The primary benefit is the annual survival income, which is a guaranteed 8% of your Basic Sum Assured, paid every year after your premium term ends, until you reach age 100. The maturity benefit, paid at age 100, includes the Sum Assured, vested bonuses, and any Final Additional Bonus (FAB).

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
sections.description: All your questions about the Jeevan Umang Calculator answered, covering long-tail keywords like 'surrender value calculator' and 'IRR'.

items.q: What is the Jeevan Umang calculator and is it free?
items.a: The Jeevan Umang calculator is a free online tool to estimate premiums, survival income and related values for LIC Plan 945. Results are illustrative, not a binding LIC quote.

items.q: How do I calculate Jeevan Umang premium?
items.a: Enter your age, BSA, and PPT into the calculator. The tool uses official LIC rate tables and modal factors to compute your premium.

items.q: What is the survival income under Jeevan Umang?
items.a: It is a guaranteed annual payment of 8% of the Basic Sum Assured, paid every year after the Premium Paying Term ends, until age 100 or death.

items.q: What is the maturity value of Jeevan Umang?
items.a: The primary benefit is lifetime income, but a maturity benefit is paid at age 100. It includes the Basic Sum Assured + all vested bonuses + any Final Additional Bonus (FAB). Our 'Jeevan Umang maturity calculator' feature provides this estimate.

items.q: How to calculate the return or IRR for Jeevan Umang?
items.a: Our tool estimates the Internal Rate of Return (IRR) by considering all premium outflows and all income inflows (survival benefits + maturity). This provides a realistic 'Jeevan Umang ROI' figure, which is typically in the 5-6% tax-free range.

items.q: Are the results from this LIC calculator accurate?
items.a: The premium calculations are highly accurate based on LIC's rules. The maturity benefits are estimates as they depend on future, non-guaranteed bonuses. Always get an official illustration from LIC.

items.q: When can I take a loan against Jeevan Umang?
items.a: You can typically avail a loan after the policy has acquired a surrender value, which is after two full years of premium payments.

items.q: How do I calculate the surrender value of Jeevan Umang?
items.a: The surrender value is complex, but our calculator provides an estimate for both Guaranteed (GSV) and Special (SSV) surrender values. It's a key feature of our 'LIC Jeevan Umang surrender value calculator'.

items.q: Is the survival income from Jeevan Umang taxable?
items.a: Under current tax laws (Section 10(10D)), the proceeds from LIC policies, including survival benefits, are generally tax-free, subject to certain conditions. Compare your tax situation using our tax regime calculator to see the tax benefits of this plan. This is a major aspect of the 'LIC Jeevan Umang tax benefits calculator' consideration.

items.q: What is the death benefit in Jeevan Umang?
items.a: Our death benefit calculator feature shows that the nominee receives the 'Sum Assured on Death' (higher of BSA or 7x annual premium) plus all vested bonuses. The 8% annual payouts stop upon the policyholder's death.

items.q: How does Jeevan Umang compare with other investment options?
items.a: Jeevan Umang offers guaranteed returns with insurance cover. Compare with PPF for tax-free savings, FD vs PPF for comparing fixed deposits, or mutual funds for market-linked growth. Use our mutual fund overlap calculator to build a diversified portfolio.

items.q: How does Jeevan Umang fit into retirement planning?
items.a: Jeevan Umang provides guaranteed lifelong income, making it ideal for retirement. Use our retirement corpus calculator to determine your total needs and compare with NPS calculator, APY calculator, and SSY calculator for other pension and retirement options.

items.q: Can I optimize my loans while investing in Jeevan Umang?
items.a: Yes, use our loan optimizer to compare loan options and potentially free up more funds for LIC investments like Jeevan Umang. Also use our surrender value calculator to understand borrowing options against your policy.

items.q: How does Jeevan Umang help with tax planning?
items.a: Premiums are eligible for tax deduction under Section 80C. Use our tax regime calculator to optimize your overall tax savings and compare Jeevan Umang with NPS, PPF, and APY for additional tax benefits.

items.q: Should I compare Jeevan Umang with other LIC plans?
items.a: Absolutely! Use our LIC premium calculator to compare premiums across different LIC plans and find the best fit for your financial goals.

sections.title: Final Verdict: Is Jeevan Umang a Good Investment?

content.text: For individuals seeking a disciplined, low-risk savings plan that provides a guaranteed, lifelong, tax-free income stream, Jeevan Umang is one of the most robust products in the market. It excels at creating a predictable 'pension' alternative, shielded from market volatility. It may not offer the high growth of equity, but for foundational financial security, its value is unmatched. For broader financial planning, explore our loan optimizer for debt management and mutual fund overlap calculator for portfolio optimization. Compare with other LIC plans using our LIC premium calculator to make the best choice. For tax optimization, check our tax regime calculator and for retirement planning, use the retirement corpus calculator.
